dog.description_text: Meet Henry — New Arrival! Henry just arrived and is still getting settled in, so we’re just beginning to learn who they are. Right now, everything is new—new people, new sounds, new routines—and we’re giving them time to relax, decompress, and show us their true personality at their own pace. Here’s what we know so far about his time in foster care: https://bestfriends.sharepoint.com/:b:/r/sites/GRP_NYC_Foster/Shared%20Documents/Forms/AllItems.aspx?id=%2Fsites%2FGRP%5FNYC%5FFoster%2FShared%20Documents%2FGeneral%2FHenry%20%2D%20About%20Me%2Epdf&parent=%2Fsites%2FGRP%5FNYC%5FFoster%2FShared%20Documents%2FGeneral&p=true&share=cQpKKBtwzCV8QYZ3DJC6p%2DQ%5FEgUDjh6VsiHMO4roVYES5OHhGg His foster says "Henry is truly the life of the party! Whatever you’re doing, he wants to be included. He’s the perfect little partner in crime whether your doing your house errands, hanging out with friends, or just relaxing watching TV, this boy will be there. He’s quite chatty & will absolutely tell you what he wants, which is most likely cuddles or for you to pick up the cat wand. He can be a little skittish with loud/sudden noises, but he bounces back quick. He is extremely goofy & would make the perfect part of your family! he loves to do everything by your side. He’s truly a little shadow. ". He is neutered, vaccinated, microchipped, and has had preventative treatments to ensure he is ready for his next steps. Submit an adoption survey from above and our team will reach out via phone or email (check spam) to schedule a counseling call. Please remember, pets cannot be held or reserved.
